title: nan
authors: Maisto P.; Scognamiglio V.; Selvaggio M.; Lippiello V.
key_contribution: Presents a low-cost multisensor method for robust UAV pose reconstruction for navigation in visually degraded, GNSS-denied sewer environments, validated via simulation and real-world experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
